title: Adoption
intro: Animals waiting for a home. Each listing shows health, age, colors and where the animal is.
accountBody: To list animals and see the giver's contact, create an account. You can browse listings without one.
responsible: Responsible adoption: meet the animal first, arrange a visit, never pay for a "free" animal and be wary of requests for money.
loadError: Couldn't load the listings. Check your connection.

empty.title: No listings here
empty.body: There are no animals for adoption with this filter yet.

emptyMine.title: You haven't listed any animal
emptyMine.body: Tap "List an animal for adoption" to start.

form.name: Name (optional)
form.nameHint: If the animal has no name yet, leave it blank.
form.healthHelp: Only list what has already been done, ideally with the date. The app never suggests vaccines, medicines or tests.
form.healthItemError: Fill in the name and check the date of each item.
form.descriptionHint: Personality, how it gets along with kids and other animals, special care...
form.locationHelp: Optional. We only keep the approximate area (about 1 km), never the exact address.
form.contactHint: Only people with an account can see your number.

noHealth: The giver didn't add health information.
contactTips: When you talk, ask about the animal's routine and arrange a visit in a safe place.
contactAccount: Create an account to see the giver's phone.

delete.title: Delete this listing?
delete.body: The listing and its photos will be deleted. This can't be undone.

gone.title: Listing not found
gone.body: It may have been deleted by its author.
